description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: Two curved woven panels hold an empty vertical napkin slot between them. Side: A narrow bamboo foot bridges the panels and resists tipping. Rear: The rear panel has a complete woven surface and concealed lower bindings. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT of a napkin holder with a SHORTER semicircular woven front panel and a TALLER semicircular rear panel. Create ONE REAR photo of this SAME object by orbiting camera exactly 180 degrees. The TALL rear semicircular panel must now be NEAREST THE CAMERA, showing its outside back woven surface as a single unobstructed tall semicircle. The shorter panel belongs on the opposite far side and must be entirely hidden behind the tall panel except perhaps at the extreme edges. Do not show the shorter panel in front of the taller one: that would repeat the front view. Preserve exact honey-tan color, hexagonal weave, rim thickness, leg counts, dimensions and material bindings. Do not change panel heights. Whole object straight-on centered, same warm-white studio background. No text, labels, numerals, logos, napkins or any props.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
